claims.assertion: Mari says Taygeta has a near-even gender ratio, with women exceeding men by at most 10%; she attributes the difference to older women living longer.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She contrasts this with older claims of a large female majority.

claims.assertion: Mari describes Taygetan men and women as equal partners with distinct gender roles, while both may pursue any social role, including science or politics.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She notes Taygeta has a queen and says this does not exclude either gender.

review_flags: source revises earlier claims about Taygetan gender ratios and social roles; compare against prior sources
